title: Desk relocation & cable management
problem: When lecturers move desks or rooms, their PCs lose network access and cables end up loose and messy.
action: Set up workstations from an empty desk, such as a four-PC dual-monitor station: measure, crimp and terminate new RJ45 cables, route them neatly along the desk and floor, and test every connection with a LAN tester.
result: Lecturers are back online the same day with clean and safe cabling.

images.caption: During: crimping the LAN cable on site
After: PCs connected, cable run through floor trunking
